sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Mr. Behera, learned Additional Standing Counsel for the Appellant submits, an incorrect submission being made by the learned Counsel for the State- Appellant on 23.02.2024 that the deficit court fee was paid belatedly on 31.01.2024.
Subsequently it was found that no court fee has been paid.
Accordingly, I.A. No.95 of 2024 was filed seeking four weeks' time to deposit the deficit court fee and I.A. No.96 of 2024 was filed for modification of the order dated 23.02.2024.
3. Mr. Behera, learned Counsel for the State-Appellant submits, the court fee of Rs.69,734/- has already been paid on 14.03.2024.
4. In view of such submission made by the learned State Counsel, the deficit court fee paid belatedly is accepted by extending the period till the date of actual deposit.
5. Accordingly, both the I.As. stand disposed of.

(S.K. MISHRA) JUDGE Order No.
06. 1.

Mr. Behera submits, though this Appeal has been preferred under Section-74 of the Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013,
but there is a typographical error crept in the cause title of the memorandum of appeal.

Accordingly,
Mr. Behera orally prays for permitting him to correct the said typographical error crept in the cause title of memorandum of appeal.

2. The said prayer is allowed.
